WITH (
  inventory = max by(resource_id,pod) (kompass_pod_info{namespace="$namespace",workload_name="$workload_name",workload_kind="$workload_kind",status="running"}),
  initial = max by(resource_id,pod) (kompass_rs_initial_requests{resource_type="cpu"}),
  actual = max by(resource_id,pod) (kompass_rs_actual_requests{resource_type="cpu"}),
  savings = 100 * (initial - actual) / initial
    and on(resource_id,pod) inventory
    and on(resource_id,pod) (initial > 0),
  complete = count by(resource_id) (savings) == count by(resource_id) (inventory)
)
avg by(resource_id) (savings) and on(resource_id) complete

WITH (
  inventory = max by(resource_id,namespace,created_by_name,created_by_kind) (
    kompass_pod_info{namespace="$namespace",namespace!~"kube[-_]system",created_by_name="$workload_name",created_by_kind="$workload_kind",status="running"}
  ),
  actions = max by(resource_id,cr_kind,phase,rightsizing_policy_name) (
    kompass_rs_action_info{management_schema="1",cr_kind=~"Action|ClusterAction",resource_id!=""}
  ),
  scoped_actions = (label_match(actions,"cr_kind","Action") and on(resource_id) label_mismatch(inventory,"created_by_kind","clustervirtualworkload"))
    or (label_match(actions,"cr_kind","ClusterAction") and on(resource_id) label_match(inventory,"created_by_kind","clustervirtualworkload")),
  schema_action = inventory and on(resource_id) scoped_actions,
  legacy_active = label_replace(
    kompass_rs_action_info{management_schema!="1",namespace="$namespace",workload_name="$workload_name",action_type=~".+"},
    "created_by_name","$1","workload_name","(.+)"
  ),
  active = (inventory and on(resource_id) label_mismatch(scoped_actions,"rightsizing_policy_name",""))
    or ((inventory and on(namespace,created_by_name) legacy_active) unless on(resource_id) schema_action),
  owners = max by(namespace,pod,container,resource_id) (
    kompass_pod_info{namespace="$namespace",workload_name="$workload_name",workload_kind="$workload_kind",status="running"}
  ),
  requests = max by(namespace,pod,container,resource_id) (
    kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu",namespace="$namespace",container!=""}
    * on(namespace,pod,container) group_left(resource_id) owners
  ),
  selected_variant = max by(resource_id,container) (
    avg_over_time(kompass_rs_recommendations{namespace="$namespace",workload_name="$workload_name",workload_kind="$workload_kind",resource_type="cpu",resource_source="desired",mode="variants",rightsizing_policy="$rs_policy",horizontal_policy="$h_policy"}[1d])
  ),
  default_variant = max by(resource_id,container) (
    avg_over_time(kompass_rs_recommendations{namespace="$namespace",workload_name="$workload_name",workload_kind="$workload_kind",resource_type="cpu",resource_source="desired",mode="variants",rightsizing_policy="$rs_policy",horizontal_policy=""}[1d])
  ) unless on(resource_id,container) selected_variant,
  variant = selected_variant or default_variant,
  with_variant = (requests * 0) + on(resource_id,container) group_left variant,
  without_variant = requests unless on(resource_id,container) variant,
  policy_requests = with_variant or without_variant,
  expected = count by(resource_id) (owners),
  complete = count by(resource_id) (requests) == expected,
  has_variant = count by(resource_id) (variant) > 0,
  current_total = sum by(resource_id) (requests),
  policy_total = sum by(resource_id) (policy_requests)
)
(100 * (current_total - policy_total) / current_total
  and on(resource_id) complete
  and on(resource_id) has_variant
  and on(resource_id) (current_total > 0)

) unless on(resource_id) active

panels.title: JVM GC Time Ratio (%)
panels.description: Average of the recorded GC time ratio over the default 30-minute JVM GC lookback; this is the ratio used to select the heap buffer.

targets.expr:
WITH (
  inventory = max by(resource_id,namespace,created_by_name,created_by_kind) (
    kompass_pod_info{namespace="$namespace",namespace!~"kube[-_]system",created_by_name="$workload_name",created_by_kind="$workload_kind",status="running"}
  ),
  unknown_workload = label_set(vector(1),"namespace","$namespace","created_by_name","$workload_name","created_by_kind","$workload_kind")
    unless on(namespace,created_by_name,created_by_kind) inventory,
  actions = max by(resource_id,cr_kind,phase,rightsizing_policy_name) (
    kompass_rs_action_info{management_schema="1",cr_kind=~"Action|ClusterAction",resource_id!=""}
  ),
  scoped_actions = (label_match(actions,"cr_kind","Action") and on(resource_id) label_mismatch(inventory,"created_by_kind","clustervirtualworkload"))
    or (label_match(actions,"cr_kind","ClusterAction") and on(resource_id) label_match(inventory,"created_by_kind","clustervirtualworkload")),
  schema_action = inventory and on(resource_id) scoped_actions,
  legacy_active = label_replace(
    kompass_rs_action_info{management_schema!="1",namespace="$namespace",workload_name="$workload_name",action_type=~".+"},
    "created_by_name","$1","workload_name","(.+)"
  ),
  active = (inventory and on(resource_id) label_mismatch(scoped_actions,"rightsizing_policy_name",""))
    or ((inventory and on(namespace,created_by_name) legacy_active) unless on(resource_id) schema_action),
  management = label_set(active,"status","Active")
    or label_set(inventory unless on(resource_id) active,"status","Inactive")
    or label_set(unknown_workload,"status","Unknown"),
  auto = inventory and on(resource_id) max by(resource_id) (kompass_pod_info{jvm_indication_source=~"auto|both",status="running"}),
  manual = inventory and on(resource_id) max by(resource_id) (kompass_pod_info{jvm_indication_source=~"manual|both",status="running"}),
  detection_values = label_set(auto and on(resource_id) manual,"detection","Both")
    or label_set(auto unless on(resource_id) manual,"detection","Auto")
    or label_set(manual unless on(resource_id) auto,"detection","Manual"),
  exporter_telemetry = (
    max by(namespace,pod,container) (
      count_over_time(jvm_memory_used_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",namespace!~"kube[-_]system",pod!="",container!=""}[3h]) > bool 0
    )
    and on(namespace,pod,container)
    max by(namespace,pod,container) (
      count_over_time(jvm_memory_init_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",namespace!~"kube[-_]system",pod!="",container!=""}[3h]) > bool 0
    )
    and on(namespace,pod,container)
    max by(namespace,pod,container) (
      count_over_time(jvm_memory_bytes_max{namespace=~"$namespace",namespace!~"kube[-_]system",pod!="",container!=""}[3h]) > bool 0
    )
    and on(namespace,pod,container)
    max by(namespace,pod,container) (
      count_over_time(jvm_gc_collection_seconds_sum{namespace=~"$namespace",namespace!~"kube[-_]system",pod!="",container!=""}[3h]) > bool 0
    )
  ),
  exporter_owners = max by(namespace,pod,container,resource_id) (
    last_over_time(kompass_pod_info{namespace="$namespace",created_by_name="$workload_name",created_by_kind="$workload_kind"}[3h])
  ),
  exporter = max by(resource_id) (exporter_owners and on(namespace,pod,container) exporter_telemetry),
  detection_rows = detection_values or label_set((inventory and on(resource_id) exporter) unless on(resource_id) (auto or manual),"detection","None"),
  exporter_state = label_set(inventory and on(resource_id) exporter,"exporter_active","Active")
    or label_set((inventory and on(resource_id) (auto or manual)) unless on(resource_id) exporter,"exporter_active","Inactive"),
  jvm_rows = management * on(resource_id) group_left(detection) detection_rows * on(resource_id) group_left(exporter_active) exporter_state,
  non_jvm_management = management unless on(resource_id) (auto or manual or exporter),
  display_rows = label_join(
    label_replace(
      label_replace(
        label_replace(jvm_rows or non_jvm_management,"status_text","Workload status: $1","status","(.+)"),
        "detection_text","JVM Detection: $1","detection","(.+)"
      ),
      "exporter_text","JVM Exporter: $1","exporter_active","(.+)"
    ),
    "display","  ","status_text","detection_text","exporter_text"
  )
)
display_rows
